name: Drifting Through The Wind
source:
In the story the player lives through the life of a bag (plastic or paper) experiencing its various interactions with the world around it. 

[From [url=https://dororochi.itch.io/drifting-through-the-wind]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这则故事中，玩家将以一只袋子（塑料袋或纸袋）的视角走过一生，体验它与周遭世界的种种交集与互动。

[摘自[url=https://dororochi.itch.io/drifting-through-the-wind]itch.io[/url]]
